sections.body: Tim Benniks is a Developer Experience and Product leader at Contentstack, where he drives DX, Developer Hub & Marketplace, MCP, and Agent Skills. Tim is a frequent speaker, content creator, ambassador for Cloudinary, Supabase, Nuxt, Algolia and Co-chair of the Enterprise AI Agents Workgroup at the MACH Alliance.
